b2-30-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Court Insists On
b2-30-01.scenario: In the lawyer's office, Buttler János gróf asks you what the church court insists on and what it takes no notice of.
b2-30-01.prompt: Tell Buttler what the court insists on and what it disregards.
cues: Say what the court insists on
b2-30-01.target: A bíróság ragaszkodik a szabályokhoz, de eltekint a tényektől.
b2-30-01.english: The court insists on the rules, but it disregards the facts.
b2-30-01.canDo: I can use allative-governing verbs like hozzájárul and ragaszkodik in institutional contexts

b2-30-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Petition Cites
b2-30-02.scenario: The lawyer is writing the petition for Buttler János gróf and asks you, his clerk, what it should cite and touch upon.
b2-30-02.prompt: Tell the lawyer what the petition refers to and what it touches upon.
cues: Say what the petition refers to
b2-30-02.target: A beadvány a törvényre hivatkozik, és kitér a tényekre.
b2-30-02.english: The petition refers to the law and touches upon the facts.
b2-30-02.canDo: I can use sublative-governing verbs like hivatkozik and kitér to cite regulations and touch upon issues

b2-30-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Transparency and Trust
b2-30-03.scenario: The lawyer tells Buttler János gróf that the offices keep their files hidden. He asks you what an office needs so that people can trust it.
b2-30-03.prompt: Tell the lawyer what makes people trust an office.
cues: Name the two things an office needs
b2-30-03.target: A hivatalnál az átláthatóság és az elszámoltathatóság erősíti a bizalmat.
b2-30-03.english: In an office, transparency and accountability strengthen trust.
b2-30-03.canDo: I can discuss public sector transparency (átláthatóság) and institutional accountability (elszámoltathatóság)

b2-30-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Appeal Against the Decision
b2-30-04.scenario: The office has rejected the petition. Buttler János gróf asks you what to do now.
b2-30-04.prompt: Tell Buttler to appeal against the decision and say why.
b2-30-04.target: Fellebbezzen a határozat ellen, mert eljárási hiba történt.
b2-30-04.english: Appeal against the decision, because a procedural error occurred.
b2-30-04.canDo: I can lodge an official appeal against a ruling using fellebbez (-ellen)

b2-30-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Insisting at the Hearing
b2-30-05.scenario: Tóth Piroska is going to a public consultation about a new road by the forest. She asks you what you will say there.
b2-30-05.prompt: Tell Piroska what you will insist on at the consultation.
b2-30-05.target: A társadalmi egyeztetésen ragaszkodom a környezet védelméhez.
b2-30-05.english: At the public consultation I will insist on protecting the environment.
b2-30-05.canDo: I can moderate or participate in a public consultation (társadalmi egyeztetés)

b2-30-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Three Points
b2-30-consolidation.scenario: The lawyer asks you for the three points of the petition, so that Buttler János gróf can read them.
b2-30-consolidation.prompt: Tell the lawyer the three points: what you insist on, what you cite, and what you appeal against.
b2-30-consolidation.target: Ragaszkodunk a jogainkhoz, hivatkozunk a törvényre, és fellebbezünk a határozat ellen.
b2-30-consolidation.english: We insist on our rights, we cite the law, and we appeal against the decision.
b2-30-consolidation.canDo: I can use verbs that take -hoz/-hez/-höz or -tól/-től (ragaszkodik, eltekint)
